summary: Internal user cannot access assigned training workspace materials and has a deadline tomorrow morning.
missing_information: Exact permission error text or screenshot
recommended_next_action: Verify the user's workspace membership and assigned access group, then confirm whether the course link requires a different permission role.
human_review_reason: Confirm requester authorization and access group before changing permissions.
routing_recommendation: Access management or training platform administrator

summary: External enterprise customer reports that the desktop client installs on lab machines but fails to launch before a workshop next week.
missing_information: Whether all five machines fail the same way
recommended_next_action: Request environment details and launch logs, then route to installation support for reproduction or known-issue matching.
human_review_reason: Validate whether the issue is environmental, installer-related, or product-related before escalation.

summary: Internal user cannot match quick start guide instructions to the menu options visible in their account.
recommended_next_action: Ask for the guide link and screenshot, then compare the documented steps against the user's role and current UI.
human_review_reason: Confirm whether the issue is documentation drift, permissions, or environment mismatch.

summary: External enterprise customer reports report export failure for reports over 200 rows after the latest update, blocking a weekly operations review.
missing_information: Application version before and after update
recommended_next_action: Collect version, error, and reproduction details, then route to product support for defect triage.
human_review_reason: Validate reproduction details and determine whether escalation to engineering is appropriate.
routing_recommendation: Product support or defect triage team

summary: Trial user is asking for beginner training to understand the basic workflow before deciding whether to continue with the trial.
missing_information: Specific workflow they are trying to learn
Preferred format such as video, article, workshop, or guided demo
recommended_next_action: Send beginner onboarding resources and offer a guided starting path based on the user's goal.
human_review_reason: Confirm that the recommended resources match the user's trial scope and product access.

summary: Internal admin requests removal of access for a contractor whose project has ended and asks whether active sessions remain.
missing_information: System or workspace access to remove
recommended_next_action: Verify admin authority, identify the contractor account and access scope, then follow the standard offboarding and session revocation process.
human_review_reason: Account removal and session revocation require authorization and auditability.

summary: External enterprise customer reports multiple users cannot access a shared dashboard before a customer review in two hours.
missing_information: Whether any users can still access it
Recent changes to permissions or service status
recommended_next_action: Escalate immediately to support ownership, check service status and permissions, and provide the customer with an initial acknowledgement and next update time.
human_review_reason: Urgent customer-impacting issue requires human escalation, ownership, and communication management.

summary: Internal user requests that the export screen remember previous filter settings to reduce repetitive weekly report setup.
missing_information: Frequency and number of affected users
Whether this behavior should be user-specific or global
recommended_next_action: Capture the request as a product enhancement idea and ask for workflow details to support prioritization.
human_review_reason: Review for product fit, duplicate requests, and prioritization context.

summary: External enterprise customer asks about uploaded file retention timing and whether uploaded files are used for model training.
missing_information: Customer contract or data processing terms
Approved security or privacy response language
recommended_next_action: Route to the approved privacy or security response owner and avoid answering until policy language is confirmed.
human_review_reason: Privacy and data retention questions require policy-accurate review before responding.

summary: Internal user reports that something failed after following instructions, but the request does not include enough detail to identify the system, task, or error.
missing_information: What system or workflow they were using
recommended_next_action: Ask clarifying questions before routing the ticket.
human_review_reason: The request is too ambiguous to route confidently without additional information.
routing_recommendation: Intake coordinator or general support triage
